sights.w: Downtown Canton car museum founded in 1978: an unrestored 1937 Ahrens-Fox fire truck, a 1922 Holmes Victoria built in Canton, plus vintage advertising and toys. Picked in Akron Life's '6 Things to Do in Canton This Summer'; listed by Visit Canton.

58-acre state nature preserve (1980) in Jackson Township — really a calcium-rich, spring-fed fen — with a boardwalk through wetland meadows holding 20+ plants rare in Ohio, including carnivorous species that bloom in summer. Free, dawn to dusk.

Nonprofit two-screen art-house cinema (2014) born from the Akron Film+Pixel cinephile club: indie films, documentaries and cult classics introduced by staff, with a bar mixing drinks to riff on the bill. Covered by Signal Akron, Akron Life, Cleveland Scene and Ideastream.

Goodyear Tire & Rubber's 1920 company hall (1,686-seat auditorium, gym, classrooms) on the old East End campus, reopened in 2016 as a 1,450-seat concert theater anchoring the East End redevelopment. NRHP-listed as Goodyear Hall; covered by Ideastream and Akron Life.
